formula.ascii: Bilinear (the default method): u = (px - minX) / cellWidth - 0.5, v = (py - y0) / rowStep - 0.5 with y0 the y of the outer edge of row 0 and rowStep the signed row step (negative for north-up grids), so integer u, v are cell centres for either row direction; fx = u - floor(u), fy = v - floor(v); z = sum of the four surrounding centres weighted (1-|i-fx|)(1-|j-fy|), indices clamped to the edge cell. A centre takes part only when both its weights are nonzero, so a point on a cell centre returns that cell. Outside the closed extent or NaN position gives NaN. Under strict a nodata (NaN, sentinel or validity 0) participating centre gives NaN; renormalize divides the valid weights by their sum. nearest returns cell floor(u + 0.5), floor(v + 0.5) clamped to the raster (the cell containing the point; the maxX and maxY edge belong to the last cell); bicubic is Catmull-Rom over 4x4 and falls back to the bilinear rule next to nodata.
